name: Midori Caret
description: Draws the editor caret, the editor selection band, the note-title caret and the note-title selection band as real elements so the Midori theme can size them. Needed because the Midori fonts carry symmetric ascent/descent overrides, which makes everything the browser derives from font metrics centre on the baseline instead of on the ink. On iOS (not Android, which honours ::selection) the native selection scrim cannot be removed, so both bands are drawn under it in the scrim's own shape: squared-off rows, and a box that leans above the baseline by the system font's lean rather than sitting centred on it. On iOS it also redraws the selection grabbers, which painting out caret-color removes; only the paint is lost, so this restores the affordance rather than the ability.
author: Benjamin Loschen
